headline: eBay Acquires Depop for $1.2 Billion to Target Gen Z Fashion Market
body: eBay has agreed to purchase secondhand fashion marketplace Depop from Etsy for about $1.2 billion in cash. The acquisition is expected to help eBay target younger fashion-loving consumers and expand its presence in the Gen Z market. - AP News

headline: Johnson Controls to Acquire Alloy Enterprises for Data Center Thermal Management
body: Johnson Controls has signed an agreement to acquire Alloy Enterprises, a Boston-based company specializing in thermal management for data centers. The acquisition will strengthen Johnson Controls' leadership in data center cooling and AI-based thermal management solutions. - Facilities Dive

headline: Sensei Biotherapeutics Acquires Faeth and Raises $200 Million
body: Sensei Biotherapeutics has acquired Faeth Therapeutics and secured approximately $200 million in funding. The strategic acquisition introduces PIKTOR, Faeth's investigational drug that combines serabelisib and sapanisertib to inhibit the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway. - El-Balad.com

headline: TRNR Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Ergatta, Increasing 2026 Revenue Guidance
body: Interactive Strength (TRNR) has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Ergatta, boosting 2026 pro forma revenue guidance by 50% to more than $30 million. The acquisition is expected to deliver over $10 million in 2026 revenue with approximately 30% EBITDA margins. - Benzinga

headline: FDA Refuses to Review Moderna's Influenza Vaccine Application
body: The U.S. FDA declined to review Moderna's flu vaccine application for its mRNA-1010 product. Moderna shares fell about 8% in extended trading following the unexpected decision. - Contagion Live

headline: Deere Shares Jump 12% After Q1 Earnings Beat and Raised Profit Outlook
body: Deere & Co. shares jumped nearly 12% to a fresh high after the farm and construction equipment maker posted Q1 earnings that exceeded expectations. The company raised its full-year 2026 profit forecast to between $4.5 billion and $5.0 billion. - Investopedia

headline: Walmart Reports Strong Holiday Growth, but Earnings Outlook Falls Short
body: Walmart reported Q4 earnings per share of 74 cents adjusted vs. 73 cents expected, with revenue climbing 5.6% year-over-year to $190.7 billion. Shares fell 1.38% on Thursday following the earnings announcement. - CNBC

headline: Opendoor Reports Strong Q4 Results, Stock Jumps 16.5%
body: Opendoor reported Q4 2025 revenue of $736 million, comfortably beating Wall Street consensus and adjusted EBITDA of -$43 million came in better than expected. The stock traded up 16.5% to $5.36 immediately following the results. - Tokenist

headline: Amazon Plans to Launch AI Content Marketplace for Publishers
body: Amazon has notified publishing industry executives that it plans to launch a specialized marketplace where media companies can sell their content to AI product developers. The initiative is expected to expand Amazon's addressable markets in the AI space. - The Information
